synthesis: Across 3 genuinely different open-weight families (Qwen/Mistral/Phi), diverse-abstention (B) REDUCES confident-wrong substantially (A_cw 182/252/124 -> B_cw 4/19/9) by ABSTAINING (coverage <1). B does NOT add NET capability: B all-task accuracy <= A in all 3. The paired subset-dominance (B_solved subset of A_solved) is STRONG for Qwen/Mistral (McNemar p<0.001) but WEAK/NON-SIGNIFICANT for Phi (27 vs 20, p=0.38) - i.e. B and A solve statistically indistinguishable task-sets for Phi, with B's few extra correct answers attributable to 3-vote resampling rather than new capability (same model/candidates).
classification: ROBUST_ACROSS_3_FAMILIES: confident-wrong reduction via abstention = SELECTIVE_PREDICTION (KNOWN). NO net capability gain in any family. NOVELTY: NONE.
honest_caveat: Phi's balanced 27-vs-20 means the 'strict subset' framing does NOT hold universally; the robust claim is the weaker+correct one: B trades coverage to cut confident-wrong, no NET capability gain.
